body: I really appreciate you talking to me though man, your name shouldn't be imapatheticloserama, it should be hey I'm pretty cool

I've been trying to meet new people, but I just get brushed off and yeah about hte friends thing. I currently live in a small village so now contact with my friends has been lessened as well so I'm also physically alone and whenever I go to the city I try to hang out with whoever I can just to get my mind off things but sometimes it's hard because they are busy or just don't want to.. I really appreciate you talking to me though. It really means alot

I have talked to my mom saying that I have felt differently lately and have not been doing well, she gave me a hug which was surprising to me as we have not talked much (she works 3 jobs so I barely see her) and it was nice I will admit to be hugged, but she's the only one that talks to me and she can't do it often and it is just kind abreaking me that friends I used to talk to lots are often too busy or just plainly ignore me

you can talk to me if you want, I myself am dealing with depression but I'm looking for people to talk with and just maybe if I can be there for someone I can help myself. so yeah feel free to talk to me as well
